description: Collection grouping/lifecycle boundary coverage: clearing a middle package out of three (insertion order of survivors preserved), clearing multiple packages in one request, clearing a package that was never added (count 0, others untouched), and an add-only request with no clear list at all. The output reports per-package counts and the list of patched packages before and after any removal.

cases.expected_output:
a/a patches=1
b/b patches=1
c/c patches=1
patched_packages=a/a,b/b,c/c
cleared=b/b
b/b patches=0
patched_packages=a/a,c/c

a/a patches=1
b/b patches=1
c/c patches=1
patched_packages=a/a,b/b,c/c
cleared=a/a,c/c
a/a patches=0
c/c patches=0
patched_packages=b/b

a/a patches=1

patched_packages=a/a,b/b
